market: Europe Modified Silane (MS Polymer) Adhesives Market
market_definition: The modified silane adhesives market comprises isocyanate-free adhesives based on silyl-terminated polyether or polyurethane polymers that cure on moisture. It measures sales of elastic bonding adhesives rather than sealant-only products. BY POLYMER BASE: Silyl-Modified Polyether (SMP), Silyl-Terminated Polyurethane (SPUR), Other Silane-Modified Polymers. BY HARDNESS: Soft / Elastic, Medium, Rigid / High-Modulus. BY PACKAGING: Cartridges, Foil Sausages, Pails & Bulk. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Building & Construction, Automotive & Transportation, Flooring & Parquet, Industrial Assembly, Marine & Rail, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Moisture-cure polyurethane adhesives; RTV silicone adhesives; stand-alone construction sealants; epoxy adhesives. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
